profileContract.rationale: The audit and repository define crate ownership and the missing interfaces across Xodus, xgameruntime, Wine or Proton, desktop presentation, and external services
The audit requires deterministic entrypoints, runtime versions, prefix state, install promotion, per title policy, benchmark scenes, and normalized support evidence
The audit records invalid input, local, dependency, authorization, service, partial success, corruption, runtime, and performance failures requiring typed recovery behavior
The locked support matrix distinguishes the exact Tier 1 machine, Tier 2 CachyOS Hyprland NVIDIA systems, and nonstable environments
The owner request fixes interactive account input, package and title inputs, launcher workflows, graphical output, local execution, cloud handoff, telemetry, and release artifacts
The owner requires signed public GitHub artifacts and a repository local CachyOS PKGBUILD while excluding AUR publication
The audit identifies path containment, secret handling, IPC authorization, package integrity, parser safety, entitlement, anti cheat, and logging boundaries
Existing documentation defines secret, device, license, and encrypted content state while the audit identifies required prefix, install, cache, profile, and benchmark state
The owner authorized bounded account backed tests and the audit supplies unit, fixture, integration, platform, performance, recovery, and real title evidence gaps
The locked coordinated repository choice requires product, schema, protocol, runtime artifact, prefix, title profile, and evidence versioning

ownerDecisions.question: Must both selected target games run locally for stable completion
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Minecraft for Windows and Forza Horizon 5 must both install, update, and run locally, and cloud does not substitute for either target.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The targets prove both the functional Game Pass chain and a demanding graphics workload. A cloud result cannot validate the local runtime.

ownerDecisions.question: Which Forza Horizon 5 performance profiles are release authoritative
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Use 3840 by 2400 High at stable 60 FPS and 2560 by 1600 High at stable 120 FPS on the internal panel, with locked frame time stability gates.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The two profiles prove a high resolution quality path and a high refresh smoothness path on the Tier 1 panel.

ownerDecisions.question: How is Windows performance context handled without Windows installation
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Do not install or boot Windows. Use qualified current online RTX 5090 Laptop benchmarks only as context, keep absolute local Linux gates authoritative, and make no exact same hardware Windows parity claim.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner rejects dual boot and temporary Windows media. Online measurements vary by TGP, CPU, cooling, driver, game revision, and method, so they cannot become the release threshold.

ownerDecisions.question: Which Game Pass account backed operations are authorized
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Authorize bounded interactive login, device provisioning, entitlement, license, download, isolated install, update, launch, save, online, cloud fallback, logout, and local cleanup without purchases, credential extraction, subscription changes, or destructive cloud save operations.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Real service and title evidence is required, but account authority remains narrow and secret values never enter repository content.

ownerDecisions.question: May completion coordinate xgameruntime and Wine or Proton work outside this repository
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Authorize coordinated EnVisione forks or pinned patch artifacts for xgameruntime and Xodus compatible Wine or Proton with versioned interfaces and provenance.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The audited repository cannot complete Game Runtime and protected executable execution by itself.

ownerDecisions.question: Which package formats and Game Runtime API breadth are mandatory
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Require MSIXVC2 and complete XSP update support for stable completion, exclude non GDK and EAppx, and defer broader Game Runtime APIs not required by supported targets.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Stable package lifecycle coverage extends beyond the two targets, while runtime API work remains driven by supported title evidence.

ownerDecisions.question: Which user facing launcher surfaces are mandatory
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Require launcher neutral CLI and service interfaces plus a thin native graphical catalog, library, install, update, and launch application.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The graphical workflow must not duplicate domain logic or lock users into one launcher.

ownerDecisions.question: How are unsupported anti cheat titles routed
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Hand unsupported anti cheat titles to the existing Greenlight application named Xbox without credential sharing or cloud as native claims.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Cloud is the allowed fallback for intentionally unsupported local execution, not a compatibility workaround or bypass.

ownerDecisions.question: Which environments receive stable support claims
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Tier 1 is the exact audited Lenovo Legion 9 18IAX10 RTX 5090 Laptop machine, Tier 2 is current CachyOS with Hyprland and supported NVIDIA drivers, and other distributions or GPUs receive no stable claim.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner requires maximum Tier 1 performance without converting machine specific evidence into unsupported general claims.

ownerDecisions.question: Which release and package endpoints are mandatory
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Require signed public GitHub release artifacts and a validated repository local CachyOS PKGBUILD, and exclude AUR publication until separate authorization.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Stable completion requires reproducible installable artifacts without silently authorizing a separate AUR publication endpoint.

ownerDecisions.question: How should target evidence be sequenced when the Phase 2 entry gate depends on runtime and lifecycle capabilities implemented only in later phases?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Use EXT-002A as the available package-metadata and integrity prerequisite for XODUS-PHASE-002 entry. Preserve the broader EXT-002 runtime, online-service, anti cheat, and target lifecycle evidence contract as later phase acceptance evidence, never as an entry condition for the implementation that must produce it.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Requiring full target runtime traces, dynamic service and anti cheat classification, and real target updates before package transactions, runtime artifacts, launcher orchestration, and lifecycle execution exist creates a dependency cycle. Splitting the entry subset preserves all evidence obligations while restoring strict sequential execution.

ownerDecisions.question: How are workspace Clippy warnings classified during phased implementation?
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Every workspace Clippy warning is an unfinished mandatory repository-owned defect. A zero exit status with warnings does not satisfy an applicable phase or release gate, and warnings must be fixed without lint suppression, test weakening, or behavior loss.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Warning-bearing verification cannot be treated as a tolerated baseline while the completion endpoint requires no known mandatory repository-owned defect and XODUS-REQ-020 requires warning-free Clippy.
